phases.name: Phase 1: Warm-Up Anchors (Week 1-2)
phases.summary: Start gentle so Gabriel feels zero frustration: Breakfast + Morning Toy/Book + Home Living English LMS / Pre-Amber 4 are 100% English (Offline Tebet postponed until Dec).
phases.rule: Use the RECAST RULE: if Gabriel replies in Indonesian ('Mama ambilkan minum'), smile warmly and say 'Can you get me water, please? Sure, here is your water!' Never scold or force repetition.

phases.name: Phase 2: Half-Day English Mode (Week 3-4)
phases.summary: Add all Toy Play, Lunch, Terrace Art, and Family Dinner Highlight in Full English.
phases.rule: Use 2-Choice Scaffolding whenever he hesitates: 'Do you want the big red block or the long blue block?' so he has the exact English words ready to pick.

phases.name: Phase 3: Full Daytime English Default (Week 5-6)
phases.summary: Every home alarm block shows English headlines & voice prompts EXCEPT Indonesian SMM school classes (Daring Rutin, PJOK, Homeroom, Agama).
phases.rule: Let the Tablet Alarm be the playful cue: 'Ooh look, Gabriel's Alarm says ENGLISH SPEAKING TIME! Let's switch our English brains ON!'

phases.name: Phase 4: 100% Full-Day Natural Habit (Week 7+)
phases.summary: Full daily English habit from Morning Wake-Up to 19:35 Goodnight Hugs, switching to Indonesian only when speaking directly to Indonesian SMM teachers.
phases.rule: Comfort-First Exception: if his sore leg hurts or he feels sad/scared, comfort him immediately in whichever language comes out first, then softly model the feeling in English.

situationScripts.title: 1. Morning Wake & Breakfast Cafe
situationScripts.parentSays: Good morning, Gabriel! Did you sleep well? Welcome to Mama's Cafe - what would you like to order today?
situationScripts.gabrielSays: Good morning, Mama! I slept great! Can I have warm milk and toast with egg, please?
situationScripts.microGame: Waiter Roleplay: Pretend to write his order on an invisible notepad - only English orders unlock the kitchen bell!

situationScripts.title: 2. Lego, Blocks & Pretend Market
situationScripts.parentSays: Whoa, that looks awesome! Tell me three things about what you're building right now.
situationScripts.gabrielSays: This is a big garage! The blue car goes super fast, and the little driver sleeps upstairs.
situationScripts.microGame: Waydivers Market Shop: Give 5 toy coins - 'How much is this apple?' 'Two coins, please! Thank you!'

situationScripts.title: 3. Sofa Storybook Detective
situationScripts.parentSays: Before I read the words, look at the picture - what do you think is happening? Why is he surprised?
situationScripts.gabrielSays: I think he found a secret door! My favorite character is the brave puppy.
situationScripts.microGame: Magic Word of the Day: Pick 1 cool English word from the book and try using it once at dinner!

situationScripts.title: 4. Afternoon Home LMS & Pre-Zoom Warmup
situationScripts.parentSays: Time for our cozy home English game! I spy with my little eye right here in the living room... something yellow!
situationScripts.gabrielSays: Is it my Lego box? Now my turn! I spy something soft and blue!
situationScripts.microGame: Home 'I Spy' + 20-min Living English LMS replaces the Tebet car ride while offline events are postponed until December 2026!

situationScripts.title: 5. Leg Comfort & Body Check-In
situationScripts.parentSays: Let's do a cozy body check - how does your leg feel on the cushion right now, scale of cozy cloud to tired?
situationScripts.gabrielSays: My leg feels comfy on the soft pillow! / My leg feels a little tired, let's rest.
situationScripts.microGame: Gives Gabriel gentle English words for physical sensations so he never feels stuck expressing comfort.

situationScripts.title: 6. Dinner Highlight & Starlight Goodnight
situationScripts.parentSays: Let's share our Rose & Bud: what was your #1 happiest moment today, and 1 thing you're excited for tomorrow?
situationScripts.gabrielSays: My rose today was building my train track! Tomorrow I'm excited for Living English!
situationScripts.microGame: 3 Grateful Whispers at 19:35 right before lights out -> calm, happy English end to every day.
